item.title: Correction · 1215 Michigan St: The page now makes clear that the Chronicle's 160,000 square feet…
item.description: The page now makes clear that the Chronicle's 160,000 square feet is not tied to this 4-acre site in the article's text, and quotes how the Chronicle names the nearby power station project. Source: https://www.sfchronicle.com/sf/article/data-center-waterfront-ai-dogpatch-22438639.php.

item.title: Correction · 1215 Michigan St: The map status changed from planned to existing
item.description: The map status changed from planned to existing. The San Francisco Chronicle (Sep 2026) reported that the site may become a data center, called the exact status of any proposal unclear and said no plans appeared to have been filed with the city; the site itself is an operating industrial yard. Also corrected: the wording that no application had been filed with SF Planning now follows the Chronicle's hedged wording, the quote from Supervisor Walton is limited to the words the paper actually quoted, the distance note marks the two-block figure as our own reckoning, and the Planning Commission hearing line no longer says none is scheduled. Its use is now 'industrial' rather than 'data_center', since the Chronicle describes the site as a crane-rental and heavy-hauling yard today. Source: San Francisco Chronicle, 2026-09-18 (https://www.sfchronicle.com/sf/article/data-center-waterfront-ai-dogpatch-22438639.php).

item.title: Added · 1215 Michigan St: New adjacent record: 1215 Michigan St, a DataSF Assessor parcel…
item.description: New adjacent record: 1215 Michigan St, a DataSF Assessor parcel (4241004, 4.07 acres) that the San Francisco Chronicle describes as a block from the Potrero Power Station redevelopment (by our own reckoning from street addresses it is closer to two blocks), currently occupied by Sheedy Drayage. The Chronicle reported Nestory Park Capital had discussed a roughly 160,000-square-foot data center for the site with city officials; the paper said the exact status of any proposal was unclear and that no plans appeared to have been filed with the city as of that report. Pier & Point records the process and does not take a position. Source: https://www.sfchronicle.com/sf/article/data-center-waterfront-ai-dogpatch-22438639.php.

item.title: Milestone · 1215 Michigan St: San Francisco Chronicle reports Nestory Park Capital met… (Sep 2026)
item.description: San Francisco Chronicle reports Nestory Park Capital met with city officials to discuss permits for a data center at the site; the paper said the exact status of any proposal was unclear, that no plans appeared to have been filed with the city, and that the property had not changed hands. (Sep 2026). Source: San Francisco Chronicle, 2026-09.
